title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: An exclamation is not an unwrap
summary: The highlight on a forced unwrap already carried a multi line oracle for raw strings. Comment blocks never got one, so an exclamation in the prose of a KDoc was marked as code.

highlights.title: KDoc prose left alone
highlights.description: Measured on a real project: 2 cases, NB: this implementation is temporary!! and a |!!| warning marker, both plain documentation.

highlights.title: Nothing else lost
highlights.description: Code that follows the end of a block on the same line is still scanned with its columns unchanged, and a block opener quoted inside a string opens nothing.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A test used to pin the old behaviour with a comment saying it documented a known limitation. It asserts the corrected behaviour now.
The same shape exists with no occurrence on that project in resource folding, colour folding and the resource diagnostics.
